description: Create a weekly egg production tracker spreadsheet for 4 backyard chickens (Henrietta, Nugget, Pepper, Goldie). Set up a grid with dates (Mon-Sun) in column A, hen names as column headers (B-E), and a Daily Total column (F). Enter sample egg production data (0 or 1 eggs per hen per day): Henrietta: 1,0,1,1,0,1,1 | Nugget: 0,1,0,1,1,0,1 | Pepper: 0,0,0,1,0,0,0 | Goldie: 1,1,0,1,1,1,1. In row 12, create SUM formulas for weekly totals per hen (=SUM(B5:B11), etc.). In row 13, create AVERAGE formulas (=AVERAGE(B5:B11), etc.). In column F (rows 5-11), create daily total formulas (=SUM(B5:E5), etc.). Apply conditional formatting to cells B12:E12 to highlight any hen with fewer than 3 eggs per week in RED. Save as 'egg_production_log.xlsx' in /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/.
